main_text.p: menta (libet D.Hieronymi uerbis uti) scriptura hæc contineat, & quicquid sacrarum est scripturarum, quicquid potest humana lingua proferre, & mortalium sensus percipere, hoc uolumine continetur: sed ut gustum præberet diuinæ sapientiæ & mysteriorum, quibus hic propheta refertus est.

Cæterum cum huic Operi patronus esset quærendus, uos imprimis occurristis, Amplissimi & nobilissimi uiri, cum propter singularem beneuolētiam, qua inter alios parentem etiam meum prosecuti estis, tum propter eximium promouendæ & propagandæ syncerioris religionis, & quæ huic seruiunt bonarum literarum studium. Quam quidem ob caussam diuinum hunc prophetam, lucubrationibus patris mei pie defuncti illustratum, uobis gratum fore confido, qui ea perspicuitate de Christi natiuitate, doctrina, morte atque resurrectione differit, ut non tã uentura scribere, quàm audita aut posita ante oculos

page.notes: No printed marginal notes; the pencil writing in the right margin is handwriting and was omitted. The first word "menta" is a fragment continued from the previous page. Possible long-s and ligature forms (æ, &, tilde and macron over e and m) were read from a small scan and should be checked. The signature "a 4" and the catchword "expli-" are read from a low-resolution image and may be imprecise.
